test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 05
subject: general
question: In which of the following fields is the B. C. Roy Award given?
solution:
• B. C. Roy Award is given annually for the excellence in the medical field.
 
• It was instituted in 1962 in memory of Dr. B. C. Roy by Medical Council of India.
 
• The first B. C. Roy Award was given to Sandip Mukherjee in 1973.
